messages:
emily: heads up — release blocked by regen diff on v1.14.0, CI says `packages/sdk/types` changed but we didn't touch API shapes.
ricardo: can you paste the diff?
emily: short one:
```
diff --git a/packages/sdk/types/index.ts b/packages/sdk/types/index.ts
@@
-export enum Priority { Low = 'low', Medium = 'medium', High = 'high' }
+export enum Priority { Medium = 'medium', Low = 'low', High = 'high' }
```
ricardo: ordering again. this is cosmetic but semantic-release wants a minor bump for any type changes.
tb: we've debated this — if codegen is non-deterministic we need two things: 1) make generation stable, 2) make release classify non-functional reorders as patch.
emily: I've got a small fix: stable-emit util that sorts enum members and object keys. opened PR #857.
ricardo: nice. add a CI job that runs regenerate twice and fails on diff. that'll catch nondeterminism before merge.
emily: added regen-doublecheck step to .github/workflows/regen.yml. CI on the branch shows regen-diff initially but after stable-emit it passes.
tb: good. also add a smoke test in release pipeline: install built package into example-app and run a minimal integration test. we've had one customer break because their app assumed enum iteration order.
emily: added smoke-app step too. it passed locally and in CI.
ci-bot: build #3562: regen-doublecheck passed, smoke-app passed.
ricardo: about semantic-release: I'll add a release hook that inspects regen-only commits and downgrades them to patch with a clear changelog note. this avoids polluting changelogs.
emily: please tag that change in CONTRIBUTING so maintainers know the rule.
tb: create an issue to track full deterministic generator work and link the PRs.
emily: ISSUE filed: https://redwood-internal/issue/5251 "deterministic codegen + regen double-run CI + release classifier". linking PRs.
publish-bot: publish queued for @redwood/sdk v1.14.0 (patch override for regen-only).
emily: merging the PR now. thanks for the quick reviews.
ricardo: nice job. monitor for any sample-app regressions.
tb: closing — reopen if publish bot complains.
